snippet.title: Bukele's War on Haiti's Gangs Runs Into Trouble With the US
snippet.description:
Trump Backs Bukele in Haiti, the State Department Doesn’t. Who Decides US Policy? In this episode of The Link, Shubhangi Sharma breaks down the diplomatic clash between Washington and El Salvador, Bukele’s military operations against Haiti’s gangs, the role of Erik Prince’s Vectus Global, and whether Trump’s “Donroe Doctrine” now means outsourcing security in America’s backyard. Plus, why a century of foreign interventions, from US Marines in 1915 to UN peacekeepers and the Kenya-led mission, has never left Haiti with a working state.

Rockets, miniguns and armoured columns are rolling into gang territory in Haiti. One gang boss is dead, and another is asking the UN for peace talks. El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele has sent more than 2,000 troops to Haiti, and two weeks in, the gangs are on the back foot. Then came a protest, from Washington.

The US State Department says Salvadoran troops are failing to coordinate, are endangering UN-backed soldiers from Chad, and that gunfire struck the US embassy, nearly hitting American staff. El Salvador has rejected every claim and questioned the credibility of America’s top diplomat in Haiti. Bukele’s reaction, according to a source close to him: “I checked with Trump.”

So who is really in charge of America’s policy in Haiti: the president who gave his blessing, or the diplomats pushing back?

snippet.title: 청와대 “수능서 AI 기기 점검·전담 인력 배치”…긴급 회의 소집 [9시 뉴스] / KBS 2026.11.15.
snippet.description:
문제는 불과 나흘 뒤면 대학수학능력시험이라는 점입니다. 정직한 수험생들이 피해를 보지 않도록 청와대는 가용 가능한 기술적 수단을 총동원하라고 지시했습니다. 이희연 기잡니다.

 [리포트]

 청와대는 정책실장 주재로 긴급회의를 소집했습니다.

 당장 나흘 앞으로 다가온 대입 수능 시험 등에 대한 우려가 커지자, 직접 대응에 나선 겁니다.

 [임광현/대통령 비서실장 : "매우 엄중하게 보고 있고, 특히 수능이 다음 주에 있기 때문에 그 부분에 대한 대책 마련에 부심을 해 왔습니다."]

 우선 19일 모든 수능 시험장에서 AI 기기 점검 절차를 마련하고, 전담 인력도  배치하도록 했습니다.
